description: Run a RunAPI operation with a caller-generated idempotency key. Asynchronous operations can optionally poll until completion.

action.description: RunAPI endpoint name, for example text_to_image

idempotency_key.description: Opaque caller-generated key for safely replaying one logical task creation.

params.description: Endpoint parameters validated against data/contract.json where constrained.

poll_interval_ms.description: Status check interval while waiting for completion.

service.description: RunAPI service slug returned by list_models

timeout_ms.description: Requested completion deadline in milliseconds; values above the endpoint limit are capped.

wait.description: Wait for the completed result when the endpoint requires durable processing.

name: create_task
